description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called ChannelsSettings, which includes a nested struct ChannelItem representing individual channel entries and manages a store of channels along with a selected channel state.

classes.name: ChannelsSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View representing settings related to channels, holding a store and the currently selected channel.

classes.name: ChannelItem
classes.description: A data structure representing a channel item with identifiable properties.
